resources.string: Name the habit or goal you want to hold yourself accountable to. This shows up on your wallpaper every day.
e.g. No smoking, No sugar, Daily workout
Give your goal a name to continue.
This sets Day 1 back to today. Your current streak of %1$d day(s) on “%2$s” will be lost. This can\'t be undone.

StreakWall stores everything you enter — your goal name, start date, and theme — only on this device, using Android's local app storage. Nothing is transmitted anywhere: there is no account, no analytics, no ad network, and no server this app talks to.

The app can set your wallpaper (to draw your day count on your home and lock screens) and run after a restart (to keep the daily update going). It also holds the standard background-scheduling permissions Android's WorkManager library adds. It does not request internet access.

Uninstalling the app deletes all of its data from your device.

This screen is a placeholder describing the app’s actual behavior. Before publishing to the Play Store, replace it with a link to a hosted privacy policy page, as Play Console requires a URL, not just in-app text.
